cat > /tmp/replace_disabletooltip.ps1 << 'EOF'
# This script replaces disableTooltip with hideHint on pill components

$workspace = "C:\Users\rafal\AppData\Local\Temp\rename-bench-no-tool-NMg6zn\workspace"

# Get all files with disableTooltip references
$files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $workspace -Recurse -Include "*.html", "*.ts" | Where-Object {
    $content = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $content -match "disableTooltip"
})

$replacements = 0

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $originalContent = $content
    
    # For HTML files and inline templates in TS files
    # Replace [disableTooltip]= with [hideHint]= on app-pill/app-fancy-pill/app-status-pill tags
    if ($file.Extension -eq ".html" -or ($file.Extension -eq ".ts" -and $content -match "<app-(pill|fancy-pill|status-pill)")) {
        # Replace [disableTooltip]= with [hideHint]= on pill tags
        $content = $content -replace '(<app-(?:pill|fancy-pill|status-pill)[^>]*?)\[disableTooltip\]', '${1}[hideHint]'
        
        # Replace bare disableTooltip attributes on pill tags (without =)
        $content = $content -replace '(<app-(?:pill|fancy-pill|status-pill)[^>]*?)\s+disableTooltip(?=\s|>)', '${1} hideHint'
    }
    
    # Replace .disableTooltip() calls on pill objects
    # This is tricky - we need to identify pill objects
    if ($file.Extension -eq ".ts") {
        # Look for patterns like pill.disableTooltip(), fancy.disableTooltip(), etc.
        $content = $content -replace '((?:pill|fancy|fancyRef|summary|firstPill|getPill|current|selected|item)\.?)\.disableTooltip\(\)', '${1}.hideHint()'
        
        # More specific patterns from the grep results
        $content = $content -replace 'fancyRef\.disableTooltip\(\)', 'fancyRef.hideHint()'
    }
    
    if ($content -ne $originalContent) {
        Set-Content -Path $file.FullName -Value $content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
        $replacements++
        Write-Host "Updated: $($file.FullName)"
    }
}

Write-Host "Total files updated: $replacements"
EOF

# Fix remaining disableTooltip -> hideHint issues in templates and CardComponent references

$workspace = "C:\Users\rafal\AppData\Local\Temp\rename-bench-no-tool-NMg6zn\workspace"

$files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path "$workspace\src\app\features" -Recurse -Include "*.ts", "*.html" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

$replacements = 0

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $originalContent = $content

    $content = $content -replace '(summary[A-Za-z0-9]*(?:<[^>]+>)?)\?\.hideHint\(\)', '${1}?.disableTooltip()'

    # Look for patterns where the variable name suggests it's a card
    $content = $content -replace '(\w*card\w*)\?\.hideHint\(\)', '${1}?.disableTooltip()'

    # Fix template references to disableTooltip property (should be hideHint)
